sources.ref: A level 60+ Barya first drops in the interludes: no Act 1 to 4 area reaches level 60 in PoB's WorldAreas, and its quest-reward file puts the interlude rows at 61 to 64

trial.1.points.note: eight ascendancy points in four pairs

trial.1.available-from.note: Trial of the Sekhemas is at area level 22 in PoB's WorldAreas; q.act-1-ogham-manor-candlemass is the progress key before the first quest row above that level, so a stage at it may have done the trial

trial.1.requirement.value: Trial of the Sekhemas in Act 2 (Balbala's Barya)

trial.2.points.note: eight ascendancy points in four pairs

trial.2.available-from.note: The Trial of Chaos is at area level 38 in PoB's WorldAreas; q.act-3-jiquani-s-machinarium-blackjaw is the progress key before the first quest row above that level, so a stage at it may have done the trial

trial.2.requirement.value: Trial of Chaos in Act 3 (Chimeral Inscribed Ultimatum)

trial.3.points.note: eight ascendancy points in four pairs

trial.3.available-from.note: two routes: a Barya of level 60+ with 3 trials, which drops in the interludes (base 54 to 56 in PoB's WorldAreas, about 62 to 64 with the dynamic +8; PoB's quest-reward rows put them at 61 to 64), so q.act-4-abandoned-prison-goddess-of-justice, the progress key before the first quest row above area level 60, may have done it; or the disputed 65+ (S15) / 75+ (S16) requirement, which is endgame. Recorded at the earlier route

trial.3.requirement.value: A Barya of level 60+ with 3 trials, or an Ultimatum with 10 trials. Its required level is disputed: 65+ (S15) or 75+ (S16)
trial.3.requirement.note: the 65+/75+ dispute is recorded as M (A-29); the Act 4 third trial is not implemented

trial.4.points.note: eight ascendancy points in four pairs

trial.4.available-from.note: level 65+ or 75+ content, past the campaign

trial.4.requirement.value: A Barya of level 75+ with 4 trials plus Zarokh, or an Ultimatum of level 75+ with 10 trials plus the Trialmaster (maxroll, S15: 65+ and three fragments)
trial.4.requirement.note: the 65+/75+ dispute is recorded as M (A-29)
